title: Private Photo Vault
summary: Secret photo vault to hide photos. Lock your private vault for pics and videos
description:
Download Private Photo Vault to join millions of users who trust our app to securely lock and hide their private photos and videos. With Private Photo Vault, you can store your personal content safely behind a vault using PIN protection, fingerprint authentication, and advanced encryption. It’s the best app for protecting your privacy and managing your photo locker.

Private Photo Vault allows you to easily hide photos and videos in a secure vault. It ensures that your sensitive media stays hidden, organized, and protected.

What you can do with Private Photo Vault:

💾 Secure special memories in a private vault
📸 Hide photos and videos away from your regular photo gallery
💼 Keep important documents like IDs and credit cards safe in a secure locker
🗂️ Organize personal albums with advanced security
🔑 Protect your photo gallery with PIN or fingerprint authentication
🕵️ Easily hide pictures and videos from public view

Import the photos you want to hide into Private Photo Vault, then delete them from your public gallery while keeping them safe in your hidden vault.

Key Features of Private Photo Vault:

🔒 Safely lock for your Photos and Videos:
• Secure your photos and videos behind a PIN, pattern, or fingerprint lock for maximum security.

💽 Backup your hidden media:
• Store your hidden photos and videos in the vault for easy recovery in case of device loss or damage.

🤫 Face Down Lock feature:
• Need instant privacy? Enable Face down lock to have Private Photo Vault lock itself when your device is facedown for added security.

Private Photo Vault Premium Features:
🔐 Album Lock:
• Assign unique PIN codes to individual albums within your vault for extra protection.

🚨 Break-In Alerts:
 • Record when someone tries to access your vault, with photos and location tracking of intruders.

👻 Fake PIN:
• Set up a decoy vault with a separate PIN code to mislead intruders.

Manage and hide pictures & videos:
☁️ Cloud Vault - Encrypted Cloud Storage:
• Store up to 50GB items securely in Private Cloud for seamless access across all devices.

🗜️ Space Saver:
• Compress your photos and keep the originals in Cloud Vault, freeing up storage space on your phone.

Personalize your experience:
🚫 Ad-Free:
• Enjoy uninterrupted privacy without ads while using Private Photo Vault.

🖼️ Custom Album Covers:
•Customize your album covers to hide the true content of your private folders.

🔒About Private Photo Vault
Private Photo Vault is designed to protect your most private content. Our mission is to provide secure, easy-to-use apps that help safeguard your personal data and enhance your privacy.

Need Help?

Visit the FAQs in the Help & Support tab within Private Photo Vault, or reach us at support@privatephotovault.com.
